headline: Comparable-sales strength fuels a sharp profit rebound
summary_short: Revenue was $8,936M (+1.9% y/y) as enterprise comparable sales grew 2.0%; diluted EPS jumped to $1.31 from $0.95 a year ago, up 37.9%.
summary_long: Comparable sales rose 2.0% enterprise-wide (domestic +1.8%, international +4.7%), lifting revenue to $8,936M (+1.9% y/y). Gross profit reached $2,102M (+2.6% y/y). Net income rose to $276M (+36.6% y/y) and diluted EPS to $1.31 (+37.9% y/y), which the release attributes to comp-sales growth plus momentum in Best Buy Ads and Marketplace. Management reiterated full-year FY2027 guidance: revenue $41.2-42.1B, comparable sales -1.0% to +1.0%, adjusted operating income rate 4.3-4.4%, adjusted diluted EPS $6.30-6.60, capex ~$750M. Q2 adjusted operating income rate was guided to ~3.9%, flat y/y. The release also disclosed a CEO transition: Corie Barry steps down at end of Q3, succeeded by Jason Bonfig. q/q deltas compare against the seasonally larger fiscal Q4 holiday quarter.

drivers.explanation: Comparable sales grew 2% versus last year, with positive comps across most product categories and strength in Best Buy Ads and Marketplace initiatives.
Enterprise comparable sales rose 2.0% (domestic +1.8%, international +4.7%), the disclosed driver of the y/y revenue increase.
